content: Instagram web feed video behavior: Reels in the web feed LOOP by default (video has loop attribute); extensions exist to strip loop so videos pause at end (kbrianps extension: 'Instagram default' = looping; 'No auto replay' is an opt-in feature) and Auto Reels Scroller exists to scroll to next reel when one ends - proving reels do NOT auto-advance in web; they loop in place. Instagram draws a click catcher overlay ON TOP of the video (extensions raise video z-index above it to reach native controls). Paused videos show poster frame; feed virtualization may remove off-screen videos. Consequence for 'block loop' lever: setting video.loop=false makes the reel pause at end and STAY (good for degradation) but Instagram may reset loop/currentTime; user tapping replay resets to full quality unless degradation re-applied per video. Reels also appear inside home feed and profiles (not only /reels/ path) - scope leakage risk.
